project.name: S.V. Fermi PWA
project.purpose: Afgeschermde ledenapp voor leden, commissies en bestuur van S.V. Fermi.

screens.reference: Approved Agenda mockup: compact dark navy header, paper-plane/calendar collage, five pill filters, orange featured event card, cream compact event cards with photographic right-side imagery.
Fermi overview preserves approved mockup: exactly three board preview cards, then committees and documents. Full board lives on /fermi/bestuur/.
Approved Community mockup: dark collage hero, member search, filter pills, 'Word ACTiEF!' committee CTA and cream member directory rows with badges.
Approved profile mockup: collage header, member summary, digital member card with QR placeholder, member stats and My Fermi settings list.
Approved event detail master now includes a rich study-trip variant matching the Budapest ’25 mockup: collage hero, travel facts, 2x2 practical grid, registration/share actions and expectations.
Full five-person board detail page; overview remains visually compact.

design_system.master_reference: Approved dark-theme mockups are the visual master. Agenda must closely follow the supplied mockup composition, spacing, orange/cream/navy palette, collage header and photographic event cards.

decisions: App is members-only in product scope.
Mobile-first PWA.
Dark Fermi theme is current visual master.
Stock placeholder images are acceptable until custom artwork is created.
GitHub Pages is used for the current static development deployment.
Routes and assets must remain compatible with /Fermi-PWA/.
Agenda event cards use relevant stock photography as temporary imagery until final Fermi artwork is available.
Agenda events use one canonical typed data source in data/agenda-events.ts.
Agenda event detail routes are statically generated for GitHub Pages compatibility.
Prototype event registration is local UI state only until authentication/backend are connected.
Study-trip event details use a dedicated travel visual variant within the shared /agenda/[slug]/ route.
Studiereis Budapest ’25 exists as a hidden-from-November-overview demo/detail route at /agenda/studiereis-budapest-25/.
Fermi primary tab is implemented at /fermi/.
Fermi page sections are Bestuur, Commissies and Documenten using the approved dark editorial collage visual language.
Community primary tab is implemented at /community/.
Community member search and filters are interactive client-side in the current prototype.
Community member data is stored centrally in data/community-members.ts.
Profile primary tab is implemented at /profiel/.
Digital member card currently uses prototype member data and a visual QR placeholder.
Profile navigation is linked from all implemented primary screens and event detail pages.
Fermi overview must not expand the complete board inline; it previews three roles to preserve the approved mockup.
Full board information is routed to /fermi/bestuur/.
Agenda month selector is interactive client-side and supports month/year rollover.
Agenda overview only renders events matching the selected month and year, with an empty-month state when no events exist.
